title: Stories, Fables, Legends, and Proverbs — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Cerita The Tortoise and the Hare. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: The tortoise sleeps under a tree.

choices.say: The tortoise sleeps under a tree.

items.reteach: Yang tidur di bawah pohon adalah kelinci (hare).

items.prompt: Cerita The Lion and the Mouse. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: The lion helps the mouse out of a net.

choices.say: The lion helps the mouse out of a net.

visual.text: The lion is free at the end.

choices.say: The lion is free at the end.

items.reteach: Yang terjerat jaring adalah singa. Tikus yang menolong singa.

items.prompt: Cerita The Fox and the Crow. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: The crow has a piece of cheese.

choices.say: The crow has a piece of cheese.

visual.text: The crow opens its beak to sing.

choices.say: The crow opens its beak to sing.

items.reteach: Yang menjatuhkan keju adalah gagak (crow).

items.prompt: Cerita The Ant and the Grasshopper. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: The grasshopper has a lot of food in winter.

choices.say: The grasshopper has a lot of food in winter.

visual.text: The ant has food in winter.

choices.say: The ant has food in winter.

items.reteach: Belalang tidak punya makanan di musim dingin.

items.prompt: Cerita The Thirsty Crow. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: The pot is full of water at the start.

choices.say: The pot is full of water at the start.

visual.text: The water is low in the pot.

choices.say: The water is low in the pot.

items.reteach: Awalnya air di kendi tinggal sedikit.

items.prompt: Cerita Kancil and the crocodiles. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: Kancil wants to cross the river.

choices.say: Kancil wants to cross the river.

items.reteach: Kancil tidak berenang. Ia melompat di punggung buaya.

items.prompt: Cerita The Boy Who Cried Wolf. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: The villagers always believe the boy.

choices.say: The villagers always believe the boy.

visual.text: A real wolf comes at the end.

choices.say: A real wolf comes at the end.

items.reteach: Di akhir cerita, warga desa tidak percaya lagi.

items.prompt: Cerita Malin Kundang. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: Malin Kundang is kind to his mother.

choices.say: Malin Kundang is kind to his mother.

items.reteach: Malin Kundang durhaka, tidak baik kepada ibunya.

items.prompt: Cerita The Ugly Duckling. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: The other ducks laugh at him.

choices.say: The other ducks laugh at him.

items.reteach: Anak itik itu menjadi angsa (swan), bukan elang.

items.prompt: Cerita Timun Mas. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: Timun Mas throws salt, and it becomes a forest.

choices.say: Timun Mas throws salt, and it becomes a forest.

visual.text: Timun Mas is safe at the end.

choices.say: Timun Mas is safe at the end.

items.reteach: Garam berubah menjadi laut (sea), bukan hutan.

items.prompt: Cerita Sura and Baya. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Dalam legenda, Sura dan Baya berkelahi.

items.prompt: Cerita Goldilocks and the Three Bears. Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat?

visual.text: Goldilocks sleeps in the biggest bed.

choices.say: Goldilocks sleeps in the biggest bed.

items.reteach: Goldilocks tidur di tempat tidur paling kecil (Baby Bear).

items.prompt: What does the dog see in the river?

stimulus.text: A dog has a bone. He sees his face in the river. He thinks it is another dog with a bigger bone. He barks, and his bone falls into the water.

visual.text: a big bone on the grass

choices.say: a big bone on the grass

items.reteach: He sees his face in the river: bayangannya sendiri.

items.prompt: Why does the dog lose his bone?

stimulus.text: A dog has a bone. He sees his face in the river. He thinks it is another dog with a bigger bone. He barks, and his bone falls into the water.

visual.text: He opens his mouth to bark.

choices.say: He opens his mouth to bark.

items.reteach: He barks, and his bone falls into the water.

items.prompt: What is the lesson of the dog story?

stimulus.text: A dog has a bone. He sees his face in the river. He thinks it is another dog with a bigger bone. He barks, and his bone falls into the water.

items.reteach: Anjing ingin tulang yang lebih besar (serakah), akhirnya kehilangan tulangnya.

items.prompt: Why can't the fox eat the grapes?

stimulus.text: A hungry fox sees grapes on a high vine. He jumps and jumps, but he cannot reach them. He walks away and says, "They are sour anyway."

items.reteach: Grapes on a high vine: anggurnya terlalu tinggi.

items.prompt: How many times does the fox try to reach the grapes?

stimulus.text: A hungry fox sees grapes on a high vine. He jumps and jumps, but he cannot reach them. He walks away and says, "They are sour anyway."

items.reteach: He jumps and jumps: berkali-kali.

items.prompt: Why does the fox say the grapes are sour?

stimulus.text: A hungry fox sees grapes on a high vine. He jumps and jumps, but he cannot reach them. He walks away and says, "They are sour anyway."

items.reteach: Rubah tidak bisa mengambilnya, lalu pura-pura anggurnya masam.

items.prompt: Who is Sura in the legend?

stimulus.text: Long ago, a shark named Sura and a crocodile named Baya fought for food in a river. People say the city of Surabaya got its name from them.

items.reteach: A shark named Sura.

items.prompt: Why do Sura and Baya fight?

stimulus.text: Long ago, a shark named Sura and a crocodile named Baya fought for food in a river. People say the city of Surabaya got its name from them.

items.reteach: They fought for food.

items.prompt: Which city got its name from Sura and Baya?

stimulus.text: Long ago, a shark named Sura and a crocodile named Baya fought for food in a river. People say the city of Surabaya got its name from them.

items.reteach: Sura + Baya = Surabaya.

items.prompt: What does Kancil want?

stimulus.text: Kancil wants to eat the fruit across the river. He tells the crocodiles, "The king wants to count you. Please line up!" Then he jumps across on their backs.

visual.text: to eat the fruit across the river

choices.say: to eat the fruit across the river

items.reteach: Kancil wants to eat the fruit across the river.

items.prompt: Is the king really counting the crocodiles?

stimulus.text: Kancil wants to eat the fruit across the river. He tells the crocodiles, "The king wants to count you. Please line up!" Then he jumps across on their backs.

items.reteach: Itu hanya akal Kancil supaya buaya berbaris.

items.prompt: Which word best describes Kancil in this story?

stimulus.text: Kancil wants to eat the fruit across the river. He tells the crocodiles, "The king wants to count you. Please line up!" Then he jumps across on their backs.

items.reteach: Kancil cerdik: clever.

items.prompt: Dino practises reading every day. Now he reads very well. Which proverb fits?

visual.text: Don't judge a book by its cover.

choices.say: Don't judge a book by its cover.

items.reteach: Berlatih setiap hari membuat pandai.

items.prompt: Rina and her friends clean the big classroom together. It is finished quickly. Which proverb fits?
items.reteach: Dikerjakan bersama jadi cepat selesai.

items.prompt: Bimo breaks a glass. He tells his mother the truth. Mom is proud of him. Which proverb fits?

visual.text: Two heads are better than one.

choices.say: Two heads are better than one.

items.reteach: Bimo jujur: honesty.

items.prompt: Tika is new in class. She looks shy, but she is very funny and kind. Which proverb fits?

visual.text: Don't judge a book by its cover.

choices.say: Don't judge a book by its cover.

items.reteach: Jangan menilai dari penampilan saja.

items.prompt: Andi is slow, but he never stops. The fast runners stop to rest, so Andi finishes first. Which proverb fits?

visual.text: Slow and steady wins the race.

choices.say: Slow and steady wins the race.

visual.text: Two heads are better than one.

choices.say: Two heads are better than one.

items.reteach: Pelan tetapi terus berusaha.

items.prompt: Lala wants to jump into the pool. Her coach says, "Check how deep it is first!" Which proverb fits?
items.reteach: Periksa dulu sebelum melompat.

items.prompt: Joni gives his homework one day late. The teacher says it is still good that he did it. Which proverb fits?

visual.text: Two heads are better than one.

choices.say: Two heads are better than one.

items.reteach: Terlambat masih lebih baik daripada tidak mengerjakan.

items.prompt: Ana cannot finish a puzzle alone. She asks Budi, and together they finish it. Which proverb fits?

visual.text: Two heads are better than one.

choices.say: Two heads are better than one.

items.reteach: Berpikir berdua lebih baik.

items.prompt: Dodi always says he will help, but he never does. Which proverb fits?

visual.text: Slow and steady wins the race.

choices.say: Slow and steady wins the race.

items.reteach: Yang penting perbuatan, bukan hanya kata-kata.

items.prompt: Mia is sick. Her friend Nina visits her and brings her homework. Which proverb fits?

visual.text: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

choices.say: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

items.reteach: Teman sejati menolong saat kita butuh.

items.prompt: Your friend runs fast in a race, but he stops to play before the finish line, like the hare. What can you tell him?

visual.text: Don't stop before the finish line!

choices.say: Don't stop before the finish line!

items.reteach: Seperti kelinci, jangan berhenti sebelum garis finis.

items.prompt: Your little brother plays all day and does not study before the test. Which fable can teach him?
items.reteach: Semut bersiap, belalang hanya bermain.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (The Tortoise and the Hare)

stimulus.text: (1) The tortoise wins. (2) The hare and the tortoise start a race. (3) The hare sleeps under a tree.

items.reteach: Lomba dimulai, kelinci tidur, kura-kura menang.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (The Lion and the Mouse)

stimulus.text: (1) The lion lets the mouse go. (2) The mouse frees the lion from a net. (3) A lion catches a little mouse.

items.reteach: Singa menangkap tikus, melepaskannya, lalu tikus menolong singa.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (The Fox and the Crow)

stimulus.text: (1) The fox asks the crow to sing. (2) The cheese falls, and the fox takes it. (3) The crow opens its beak to sing.

items.reteach: Rubah meminta gagak bernyanyi, gagak membuka paruh, keju jatuh.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (The Ant and the Grasshopper)

stimulus.text: (1) Winter comes, and the grasshopper is hungry. (2) In summer, the ant works and the grasshopper sings. (3) The grasshopper asks the ant for food.

items.reteach: Musim panas, lalu musim dingin, lalu belalang meminta makanan.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (The Thirsty Crow)

stimulus.text: (1) The water comes up, and the crow drinks. (2) The crow drops stones into the pot. (3) A thirsty crow finds a pot with a little water.

items.reteach: Gagak menemukan kendi, memasukkan batu, lalu minum.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (Kancil)

stimulus.text: (1) Kancil jumps across on their backs. (2) Kancil wants to cross the river. (3) He asks the crocodiles to line up.

items.reteach: Ingin menyeberang, meminta buaya berbaris, lalu melompat.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (The Boy Who Cried Wolf)

stimulus.text: (1) The boy shouts "Wolf!" as a joke. (2) A real wolf comes, but nobody helps. (3) The villagers run to help, but there is no wolf.

items.reteach: Berbohong, warga datang, lalu serigala sungguhan datang.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (The Ugly Duckling)

stimulus.text: (1) He grows into a beautiful swan. (2) A strange baby bird comes out of an egg. (3) The other ducks laugh at him.

items.reteach: Menetas, ditertawakan, lalu menjadi angsa.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (Timun Mas)

stimulus.text: (1) She throws salt, and it becomes a sea. (2) Timun Mas is safe at last. (3) A giant chases Timun Mas.

items.reteach: Dikejar raksasa, melempar garam, lalu selamat.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (Malin Kundang)

stimulus.text: (1) Malin Kundang becomes rich. (2) He says she is not his mother. (3) His old mother comes to see him.

items.reteach: Menjadi kaya, ibunya datang, lalu ia tidak mengakui ibunya.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (Goldilocks)

stimulus.text: (1) She sleeps in the little bed. (2) Goldilocks eats the porridge. (3) The bears come home and find her.

items.reteach: Makan bubur, tidur, lalu beruang pulang.

items.prompt: Susun kalimat menjadi cerita yang runtut. (Keong Mas)

stimulus.text: (1) She takes it home. (2) The snail turns into a princess. (3) An old woman finds a golden snail.

items.reteach: Menemukan keong, membawanya pulang, lalu keong menjadi putri.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am very small. I help a big lion. Who am I?
items.reteach: Dalam The Lion and the Mouse, tikus menolong singa.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am clever and small. I trick the crocodiles to cross the river. Who am I?
items.reteach: Kancil si kancil yang cerdik.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am slow, but I win the race. Who am I?
items.reteach: Kura-kura (tortoise) lambat tetapi menang.

items.prompt: Odd one out from "The Fox and the Crow": the fox, the crow, the cheese, the tortoise
items.reteach: Rubah, gagak, dan keju ada di The Fox and the Crow. Kura-kura tidak.

items.prompt: Which story teaches "Don't tell lies"?
items.reteach: Anak penggembala yang berbohong akhirnya tidak dipercaya.

items.prompt: Which story teaches "Think of a clever way to solve a problem"?
items.reteach: Gagak yang haus memakai batu supaya air naik.

items.prompt: Complete the proverb: "Practice makes ___."
items.reteach: Practice makes perfect.

items.prompt: Complete the proverb: "Better late than ___."
items.reteach: Better late than never.

items.prompt: Which proverb is about telling the truth?
items.reteach: Honesty = kejujuran.

items.prompt: Odd one out: Once upon a time, Long ago, One day, The end
items.reteach: Once upon a time, long ago, one day untuk awal cerita. The end untuk akhir.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am rude to my mother, and at the end I turn into a stone. Who am I?
items.reteach: Malin Kundang durhaka dan dikutuk menjadi batu.

items.prompt: The hare is fast. The tortoise is …
items.reteach: Hare (cepat) ↔ tortoise (lambat): slow.
